scope: Every changed file of the Contracts closure package; independent semantic review of the complete structured delta, not acceptance by path prefix.

reviewEvidence.method: Independent Spec review checked complete payloads, exact continuation inputs, cyclic member ordering, gas traces, registry changes, and manifest bytes. Standards review checked the matching runtime/reference constructors.
reviewEvidence.continuationInputs: C-CLO-23-01 through C-CLO-23-05 and C-CLO-35-01 preserve the full exact content and identity of the preceding newly generated step.
reviewEvidence.gasExplanation: Except C33, only objectMemberRebuilt and directIdentityHashBlock quantities increase for the new canonical entry or its finalization. C33 combines +4 for the typed entry with -22 for reuse of two unchanged B canonical limit forms (two sets of nodeIdentity=1, objectMembers=5, hashBlocks=5).
reviewEvidence.manifestExplanation: 29 fixture lengths and 16 oracle lengths equal actual bytes. The release implementation inventory shifts by one VerifiedReferenceContents.java row; matching rows by path leaves only hashes changed and no removals.
reviewEvidence.preserved: Business payloads, accept/reject outcomes, historical exact content, and the direct BlueId algorithm.
reviewEvidence.rawDeltaGenerator: blue-conformance/src/main/tools/classify_fixture_identity_delta.py; its older transition labels require this explicit bounded review.
reviewEvidence.legacyClassifierDiagnostic: The extra C-EVO release integrity row is an aggregate validation diagnostic, not a 109th file. Its old fixture/registry/release pins rotate through the individually reviewed files. The regenerated package passes its authoritative validator.
